content: libkrun 1.19.6 (libkrun/libkrun, crate source read): with no virtio-net device the implicit vsock device enables TSI HIJACK_INET, giving the guest host network access. Must call krun_disable_implicit_vsock then krun_add_vsock(ctx,0). krun_start_enter never returns on success and exit()s the process. krun_set_root_disk_remount uses a NullFs virtiofs root (no host dir). krun_add_disk2 with RAW format; never probe formats. Homebrew tap is libkrun/krun (brew tap libkrun/krun; brew trust libkrun/krun), libkrun 1.19.6 built BLK=1 NET=1 GPU=1, libkrunfw 5.6.2 (Linux 6.12, ext4/squashfs(zlib,zstd)/erofs/vsock built in).
